description: Resolve routing-rule --agent name or id through the existing project-scoped CLI Agent resolver before create/edit mutations.

tasks.title: Resolve routing rule Agent references before mutation
tasks.description: Reuse AgentCommands.ResolveAgentAsync after project resolution for routing-rule create and supplied edit --agent values, then send the unchanged stable agentId field to the existing endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Create resolves both Agent name and Agent id through the existing resolver and sends the same stable agentId for both forms.
Edit resolves a supplied Agent name or Agent id through the same resolver and sends the stable agentId; edit without --agent preserves omission semantics.
Unknown supplied input fails with non-zero status, identifies the exact original input, and sends no routing mutation request.
Resolution occurs in the selected project and preserves existing resolver matching, transport, and error behavior.
No backend, routing DSL, rule-reference, endpoint, schema, or routing-engine changes are introduced.
tasks.output: CLI routing-rule Agent reference resolution using the existing resolver seam.

Edit-by-name and edit-by-id tests assert identical stable agentId request values and lookup-before-PATCH ordering.
